flamerJ59Reconciled.description: Explicit distinction between Camera Shake RMS, Camera Pushback, and Viewmodel Gun Pushback
flamerJ59Reconciled.notes: TG flat floor exhibits 0.0013 cm RMS cam shake; Woods terrain/ambient motion exhibits 0.0525 cm RMS cam shake (both 99-100% reduction vs round 0 baseline 5.191 cm). Viewmodel gun pushback has nominal authored target 3.0 cm (game/viewmodel.js PB = VM.push || { back: 0.03 }), while camera bodily translation is 0.39-0.42 cm. Both metrics support J59 verdict.
